north_star: Frontier-level problem solving with minimum necessary computation
hypothesis: Does an own-weight typed structural proposer trained on independently verified TRAIN programs with Stitch-derived reusable macros create a novel H0-outside executable operator with a positive causal contribution on independently authored original problems?

task_splits.train: licensed independent authored examples; original sources legal to open
task_splits.dev: opened different source targets used for design only
task_splits.test: unopened, independent author, immutable Git blob and original metadata sealed before first source-body access
task_splits.cross_formalism: separate independent author and different mechanism/formal family, not array-stage-count variation

roles.learned_student: trained proposer uses OWN weights, not teacher inference at evaluation
roles.optional_stitch: pinned TRAIN-only macro miner; independently expand and verify, not Q3 evidence by itself
roles.separate_external_teacher: separately charged API/reference; never attribute generated code to student

future_thresholds_proposed_not_frozen.Q3_scoped: at least one independently authored original solved via learned newly proposed operator, absent from frozen H0, and positive ablation
future_thresholds_proposed_not_frozen.Q6_scoped: frozen student transfers to second, distinct formal family meeting predeclared independent proof gate
future_thresholds_proposed_not_frozen.Q4_Q5: same verified capability total cost, including training/discovery/proof/failed attempts/fallback and amortized independent reuse

pretransfer_interface_gate.rule: Direct macro reuse requires frozen target/source DSL ID, typed input/output signatures, and a complete supported-operator metadata set BEFORE opening target problem bodies. No matching operators or unknown signatures -> ABSTAIN, not source test.
pretransfer_interface_gate.cross_formalism: If target DSL differs, the learner must PROPOSE a typed translation/representation from public data; an independent target-original proof must validate it before admission. Do not fake same-DSL reuse.
pretransfer_interface_gate.limitation: This is compatibility and safety filtering, not proof of semantic correctness or learned Q6 transfer.
pretransfer_interface_gate.failure_origin: PR #670 first external program-corpus transfer 0/750: target lacked all T/M/repeat/tan operators used by source macro
